description: Agent Control: submit an environment-separation design: sandbox and production credentials (who holds each, whether production accepts it, whether it is predictable), internal tools and production endpoints (reach from the sandbox, internet exposure, accepted credentials, bulk access, rate limit) and the sandbox egress default. The signed report names every ordinary path from the sandbox to a production effect (a credential valid in both, a predictable credential, a reachable endpoint that takes no credential or a sandbox one, bulk access with no rate limit) and the smallest change that closes each. What an agent may do inside its environment is wever_authority-scope-check. Verdict escape_path_open, separation_unverified or contained. POST /api/escape-path-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-control-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-control/.

in_sandbox.description: The sandbox holds or can read it.

predictable.description: A default, shared, hard-coded or guessable value.

accepts.description: Credentials it accepts; an empty list means none.

bulk.description: One call can read or change many records.

rate_limit.description: Such as 100 per minute, or none.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
